0.27.0-rc.8.en:
Fixed

- Show the saved Claude conversation name after long metadata prefixes, and report a list-sync failure instead of silently keeping an old title.

Improved

- Reduce repeated Windows directory traversal during Codex history scans and archive preparation while keeping fresh file reads and source checks.

Important

- This is a prerelease. Stable Latest remains unchanged. No automatic migration, restore or deletion is performed.
- Archive, restore and permanent-delete safeguards remain unchanged. Claude and OpenCode permanent deletion is still unavailable.
- Performance measurements used isolated synthetic histories and do not guarantee a fixed duration for real sessions. Live model sessions, installed application acceptance, native All, D20 and signed installation/return remain separately unverified. Updater signatures are not Windows Authenticode.
0.27.0-rc.8.zh:
修复

- Claude 会话包含较长元数据前缀时，正确显示已保存的新名称；列表同步失败会明确提示，不再静默保留旧标题。

优化

- 减少 Windows 上 Codex 历史扫描和归档准备期间的重复目录遍历，保留新鲜文件读取与来源校验。

重要说明

- 这是预发布版本，稳定 Latest 保持不变。不自动迁移、恢复或删除数据。
- 归档、恢复和永久删除的安全校验保持不变。Claude 和 OpenCode 永久删除仍未开放。
- 性能测量使用隔离的合成历史，不保证真实会话的固定耗时。真实模型会话、完整安装版、native All、D20 和签名安装及返回旧版验收仍需单独验证。updater 签名不代表 Windows Authenticode。

0.27.0-rc.7.en:
Fixed

- Show archive completion once the exact native root has been verified, while the session list continues refreshing in the background. Keep genuine history-read warnings visible and uncertain writes behind read-only verification.
- Combine repeated history refreshes and unknown-archive checks to avoid redundant scans, especially with many sessions or projects.

Improved

- Remove the separate Claude recovery and OpenCode native-archive panels from the archive drawer. Existing Claude recovery records remain available inline for safe restore, and already natively archived OpenCode rows retain their individual restore action.

Important

- This is a prerelease. Stable Latest remains unchanged. No automatic data migration, restore or deletion is performed. Back up important data.
- Normal Desk archive/restore and Codex native archive/permanent-delete safeguards remain unchanged. Claude and OpenCode permanent deletion is still unavailable; new Claude recovery removals and OpenCode native archives are no longer offered by the UI.
- Codex archive success verifies the selected root, not all descendants or external writers. Existing recovery and native restore still require a supported, verified Windows source; unknown outcomes are reconciled read-only and are not automatically retried.
- Isolated tests do not certify live model sessions, the installed application, native All, D20 or signed installation/return. Updater signatures are not Windows Authenticode.
0.27.0-rc.7.zh:
修复

- 准确原生根会话核实归档后即显示完成，历史列表继续后台同步；真实读取失败仍会提示，结果不确定时只读核对，不重试写入。
- 合并重复历史刷新和未知归档状态检查，减少会话或项目较多时的重复扫描。

优化

- 从归档抽屉移除独立的 Claude 恢复区和 OpenCode 原生归档面板。已有 Claude 恢复记录仍可内联安全找回，已原生归档的 OpenCode 行保留单条恢复入口。

重要说明

- 这是预发布版本，稳定 Latest 保持不变。不自动迁移、恢复或删除数据，请备份重要数据。
- 普通 Desk 归档/恢复、Codex 原生归档及永久删除的安全校验保持不变。Claude 和 OpenCode 永久删除仍未开放；界面不再提供新增 Claude 恢复区移除或 OpenCode 原生归档。
- Codex 归档成功只核实所选根会话，不代表全部后代或外部写入已完成。旧数据找回与原生恢复仍要求受支持且已核实的 Windows 来源；结果未知时仅做只读核对，不自动重试。
- 隔离测试不能替代真实模型会话、完整安装版、native All、D20 或签名安装及返回旧版验收。updater 签名不代表 Windows Authenticode.

0.27.0-rc.6.en:
Added

- A separate Claude recovery area on Windows: move the verified main transcript to a persistent recovery location and restore it without overwriting another file.
- Reversible OpenCode native archive and restore on Windows through a separate panel. Restoring native state does not start a terminal or automatically remove the Desk archive marker.

Fixed

- Allow Codex archiving with verified unrelated structured sessions open, while blocking related sessions, unknown activity and conflicting maintenance.
- Accept canonical Windows history paths during rename and keep metadata-operation ownership until helper cleanup finishes.

Important

- This is a prerelease. Stable Latest remains unchanged. Claude and OpenCode permanent deletion is not implemented and remains disabled; these recovery and archive features are not permanent deletion. Existing Codex deletion remains a separate Windows-only operation with its own review and confirmations.
- Claude recovery moves only the main transcript, leaving children, attachments and native indexes in place. OpenCode archive preserves records and requires Node.js 24.18 or newer and a supported local database schema. Unknown sources or outcomes are refused or reconciled read-only, never automatically retried.
- These operations require eligible closed, Desk-archived records and verified local sources. Claude recovery and OpenCode archive require a supported Windows/NTFS source and idle CC Desk runtimes; the Codex concurrency exception does not apply to them. Existing Desk markers are not migrated automatically. Back up important data.
- Isolated Windows WebView checks cover the production controls and authenticated IPC; the OpenCode path runs the official metadata helper against synthetic data. They do not certify an installed application, real model sessions, complete descendants or external writers. D20/native All and signed installation/return remain unverified. Updater signatures are not Windows Authenticode.
0.27.0-rc.6.zh:
新增

- Windows 提供独立的 Claude 恢复区：将已核实的主会话记录移到持久恢复位置，并支持不覆盖现有文件的恢复。
- Windows 提供独立的 OpenCode 原生归档与恢复面板。恢复原生状态不会启动终端，也不会自动清除 Desk 归档标记。

修复

- 无关的结构化会话经核实后不再阻止 Codex 归档；相关会话、未知活动和冲突维护仍会阻止操作。
- 重命名正确接纳 Windows 规范历史路径；元数据辅助进程清理完成前继续保留操作所有权。

重要说明

- 这是预发布版本，稳定 Latest 保持不变。Claude 和 OpenCode 永久删除尚未实现，入口继续关闭；恢复区和原生归档不等于永久删除。既有 Codex 删除仍是 Windows 上带独立复核与确认的操作。
- Claude 仅移动主 transcript，子任务、附件和原生索引保留原地。OpenCode 归档保留记录，需要 Node.js 24.18 或更新版本及受支持的本地数据库结构。未知来源拒绝操作，结果不确定时只读核对，不自动重试写入。
- 新功能仅适用于符合条件、已关闭且已在 Desk 归档的记录和核实的本地来源。Claude 恢复区与 OpenCode 归档要求受支持的 Windows/NTFS 来源及 CC Desk 运行时空闲，不沿用 Codex 并发例外。旧 Desk 标记不会自动迁移，请备份重要数据。
- 隔离 Windows WebView 检查覆盖生产控件和认证 IPC，OpenCode 路径通过官方元数据 helper 操作合成数据；不代表完整安装版、真实模型会话、完整后代或外部写入已验收。D20/native All、签名安装及返回旧版仍未验证。updater 签名不代表 Windows Authenticode。

0.27.0-rc.5.en:
Fixed

- Allow Windows Codex native archiving while unrelated structured Claude, OpenCode or Legacy sessions are open. Keep Codex, raw, unknown and maintenance activity blocking unsafe writes.
- Return archive feedback without a redundant full history scan and shorten cleanup after the official metadata operation completes.

Improved

- Archive closed or stopped sessions with one click. Running sessions still require stop-and-archive confirmation, and permanent deletion keeps its separate preview and confirmations.

Important

- This is a prerelease. Stable Latest remains unchanged. Native archiving is Windows Codex only; Claude and OpenCode retain Desk-only hiding. Existing Desk-only archives require restoring the display marker before explicit native archive.
- Native archive may affect child sessions, stop active descendants and involve other projects. Success verifies the root only; descendant completion remains unverified. Uncertain writes are reconciled read-only and are not automatically replayed.
- Synthetic checks do not certify real Codex archive/delete, installed Windows WebView2, complete descendants or external writers. D20/native All and signed installation/return remain unverified. Updater signatures are not Windows Authenticode.
0.27.0-rc.5.zh:
修复

- 无关的结构化 Claude、OpenCode 或 Legacy 会话打开时，不再阻止 Windows Codex 原生归档；Codex、raw、未知活动及维护操作仍会阻止不安全写入。
- 归档前不再重复全量扫描历史，更快返回操作反馈；官方元数据操作完成后，缩短辅助进程清理等待。

优化

- 已关闭或已停止的会话可一键归档。运行中会话仍需确认停止并归档，永久删除保留独立预览和确认流程。

重要说明

- 这是预发布版本，稳定 Latest 保持不变。原生归档仅限 Windows Codex；Claude 和 OpenCode 保留 Desk 隐藏行为。旧 Desk-only 归档需先恢复显示标记，再显式选择原生归档。
- 原生归档可能影响子会话、停止活动后代并涉及其他项目。成功仅核实根会话，后代是否全部完成仍未验证。结果不确定时仅做只读核对，不自动重试写入。
- 合成检查不代表真实 Codex 归档/删除、已安装 Windows WebView2、完整后代或外部写入已验收。D20/native All、签名安装及返回旧版仍未验证。updater 签名不代表 Windows Authenticode。

0.27.0-rc.4.en:
Fixed

- Connect Windows Codex Native archive to the official metadata API instead of only hiding the session in CC Desk. Verify the archived root and refresh already loaded projects from the same source.
- Keep uncertain archive results behind read-only reconciliation rather than retrying the write. Preserve exact source, profile, session and activity checks.

Important

- This is a prerelease. Stable Latest remains unchanged. Native archiving is currently Windows Codex only; Claude and OpenCode keep their existing Desk-only hide behavior, and native archiving on Unix is unavailable.
- Existing Desk-only archives are not migrated automatically. Restore their Desk display marker first, then explicitly choose Native archive. Permanent deletion still requires a natively archived eligible root and its separate preview and confirmations.
- The official archive operation may affect the native child-session tree, stop active descendants and affect other projects. A successful receipt verifies only the root; descendant completion remains unverified.
- Isolated synthetic metadata-server checks do not certify real Codex CLI archive/delete, installed Windows WebView2, complete descendants or external-writer cases. D20/native All and signed installation/return roundtrips remain unverified. Updater signatures do not certify those behaviors or Windows Authenticode.
0.27.0-rc.4.zh:
修复

- Windows Codex 的“原生归档”接通官方元数据接口，不再只是从 CC Desk 隐藏会话。核实根会话已原生归档，并刷新同来源下已加载的项目。
- 归档结果不确定时仅做只读核对，不重试写入；保留精确来源、配置、会话与活动检查。

重要说明

- 这是预发布版本，稳定 Latest 保持不变。原生归档目前仅限 Windows Codex；Claude 和 OpenCode 保留既有的 Desk 隐藏行为，Unix 原生归档暂不可用。
- 旧 Desk-only 归档不会自动迁移。请先恢复其 Desk 显示标记，再显式选择“原生归档”。永久删除仍只接受符合条件的原生已归档根，并保留独立预览和确认流程。
- 官方归档可能影响原生子会话树、停止活动后代并涉及其他项目。成功回执仅核实根会话，后代是否全部完成仍未验证。
- 隔离的合成元数据服务测试不代表真实 Codex CLI 归档/删除、已安装 Windows WebView2、完整后代或外部写入场景已验收。D20/native All、签名安装及返回旧版仍未验证。updater 签名不能证明这些行为，也不代表 Windows Authenticode。

0.27.0-rc.3.en:
Improved

- Open permanent-delete review from a separate icon at the end of each archived session row. Remove the permanent-delete module below the list and keep existing deletion receipts available from the drawer's result icon.

Fixed

- Allow known natively archived Codex sessions with bounded history metadata or shortened titles to reach read-only deletion preview. Show specific reasons when activity, missing sources, read failures or Desk-only archiving block review.

Important

- This is a prerelease. Stable Latest remains unchanged. Permanent deletion is still limited to eligible archived Codex roots on Windows; Claude, OpenCode and Unix remain unavailable.
- Permanent deletion cannot be undone. Review still requires two separate confirmations and both risk acknowledgements. The selected native root and its execution-time subtree are the scope; the preview is not a complete frozen descendant list. Existing source, activity, expiry and one-shot execution checks remain in force.
- These interface changes were checked with synthetic history and a browser bridge. Real Codex CLI deletion, installed Windows WebView2, full descendant and external-writer cases, D20/native All and signed upgrade/return roundtrips remain unverified. Updater signatures do not certify those behaviors or Windows Authenticode.
0.27.0-rc.3.zh:
优化

- 每条归档会话行尾提供独立删除图标，点击后进入永久删除复核。移除列表下方的永久删除模块，已有删除回执仍可从抽屉的结果图标查看。

修复

- 已知原生归档的 Codex 会话不再因有界历史元数据或标题截断而被误拦，可进入只读删除预览；活动、来源缺失、读取失败或仅在 Desk 中归档时，显示具体不可用原因。

重要说明

- 这是预发布版本，稳定 Latest 保持不变。永久删除仍仅限 Windows 上符合条件的已归档 Codex 根会话；Claude、OpenCode 和 Unix 仍不可用。
- 永久删除不可恢复。仍须两次独立确认和两个风险勾选；范围为所选原生根及执行时子树，预览不代表完整冻结的后代清单。来源、活动、票据时限和一次性执行检查保持不变。
- 本轮界面改动已用合成历史和浏览器桥验证。真实 Codex CLI 删除、已安装 Windows WebView2、完整后代与外部写入场景、D20/native All、签名升级后返回旧版仍未验收。updater 签名不能证明这些行为，也不代表 Windows Authenticode。

0.27.0-rc.2.en:
Added

- Select multiple eligible archived Codex sessions on Windows, filter by name, CLI or project, and review one batch before two separate confirmations. Selected roots run in sequence without another confirmation for each item.

Fixed

- Keep previews for other roots valid after one root in the same history source is deleted. Recheck the selected root's source, original files and configuration before dispatch.
- Stop unsent items on cancellation, expired previews, changed sources, blocked results or uncertain outcomes. Preserve per-item receipts and refresh each acknowledged original source once.

Important

- This is a prerelease. Stable Latest remains unchanged. Claude, OpenCode and Unix permanent deletion remain unavailable.
- Permanent deletion cannot be undone. A batch is not atomic and does not roll back completed items. A selected root includes its native subtree at execution time; the preview is not a complete frozen descendant list. Previews expire after 120 seconds, so large or delayed batches may need a smaller new selection and fresh confirmations.
- Batch behavior was checked with synthetic files, subprocesses and a browser bridge. Real Codex CLI batch deletion, installed Windows WebView2, full descendant and external-writer cases, D20/native All and signed upgrade/return roundtrips remain unverified. Updater signatures do not certify those behaviors or Windows Authenticode.
0.27.0-rc.2.zh:
新增

- Windows 可多选符合条件的已归档 Codex 会话，按名称、CLI 或项目筛选，统一预览并经过两次独立确认。确认后按顺序执行，无需逐项再次确认。

修复

- 删除同一历史来源中的一个根后，其他根的预览继续有效；发送前重新核对所选根的来源、原始文件和配置。
- 取消、预览过期、来源变化、被阻止或结果不确定时停止尚未发送的项目，保留逐项回执，并按已确认删除的原来源合并刷新。

重要说明

- 这是预发布版本，稳定 Latest 保持不变。Claude、OpenCode 和 Unix 永久删除仍不可用。
- 永久删除不可恢复。批次不是原子事务，已完成项目不会回滚。所选根包含执行时的原生子树，预览不代表完整冻结的后代清单。预览在 120 秒后过期，大批次或等待较久时可能需要缩小选择并重新预览确认。
- 批量行为已用合成文件、子进程和浏览器桥验证。真实 Codex CLI 批量删除、已安装 Windows WebView2、完整后代与外部写入场景、D20/native All、签名升级后返回旧版仍未验收。updater 签名不能证明这些行为，也不代表 Windows Authenticode。

0.27.0-rc.1.en:
Added

- Choose Stable, Test or Preview updates. Stable remains the default; returning to Stable never silently downgrades. Updates show their current stage, support bounded cancellation, and reject stale or untrusted candidates.
- Browse historical release information and manual recovery guidance. Ignore one exact candidate without hiding later versions, and review local update history or retry a failed check.
- Copy local redacted diagnostics, including bounded version probes for the selected CLI profile. Nothing is uploaded automatically.
- Permanently delete eligible archived Codex roots on Windows with a preview, two separate confirmations and explicit irreversible-risk warnings. The native root and its execution-time subtree are the scope; the preview does not claim a complete frozen descendant list. Active or unproven sources are refused. Unknown outcomes are checked before any retry.

Fixed

- Restore native Ctrl+V and paste handling in structured Windows Codex sessions without forwarding clipboard text or replaying uncertain input.
- Validate compressed Codex history when the native API reports a missing logical .jsonl path, while preserving source and session identity. Metadata rename requests explicit login and makes no model call.
- Keep invalidated delete previews queryable before dispatch. Refresh the original source after a delete is acknowledged, including through read-only reconciliation after switching targets, and preserve unrelated history rows.

Important

- This is a prerelease. Stable Latest remains unchanged. Claude and OpenCode permanent deletion remain disabled because their source or writer protection is not yet sufficient.
- Isolated product-backend deletion of one synthetic original was verified with Codex 0.167. The permanent-delete document IPC and visible WebView path remain unverified after a blocked test-instance lifecycle. Full descendants and partial failures, Unix, installed application behavior, D20/native All, real AI naming and signed upgrade/return roundtrips remain unverified. These limits are not certified by updater signatures; Windows Authenticode is also separate.
0.27.0-rc.1.zh:
新增

- 可选择稳定、测试或预览更新通道。默认使用稳定通道，切回稳定不会自动降级；更新显示当前阶段，支持有界取消，并拒绝过期或不受信任的候选。
- 查看历史版本信息和手动恢复指南；可忽略单个精确候选而不屏蔽后续版本，查看本地更新记录或重试失败的检查。
- 复制默认脱敏的本地诊断摘要，包含所选 CLI 配置的有界版本探测，不会自动上传。
- Windows 可永久删除符合条件的已归档 Codex 根会话。提供预览、两次独立确认和不可恢复风险提示；范围是所选原生根及执行时原生子树，预览不声称完整冻结所有后代。活动或来源不明对象会被拒绝，结果不确定时先核查再考虑重试。

修复

- 恢复 Windows 结构化 Codex 会话的原生 Ctrl+V 和粘贴处理，不转发剪贴板正文，不重放结果不确定的输入。
- Codex 返回不存在的逻辑 .jsonl 路径时，可在同一受控来源中验证精确同名压缩历史，保留会话身份校验；元数据改名要求显式登录，不调用模型。
- 删除预览在发送前失效时仍可核查；确认删除后刷新操作的原来源，包括切换目标后经只读核查确认的情况，并保留无关历史行。

重要说明

- 这是预发布版本，稳定 Latest 保持不变。Claude 和 OpenCode 永久删除仍关闭，原因是来源或写入活动保护尚不充分。
- 已用 Codex 0.167 验证产品后端删除单个隔离合成原件；永久删除的 document IPC 和可见 WebView 链路因原测试实例生命周期受阻仍未验收。完整后代与部分失败、Unix、安装版行为、D20/native All、真实 AI 命名和签名升级后返回旧版均未验收。updater 签名不能证明这些体验，也不代表 Windows Authenticode。

0.26.0.en:
Fixed

- Retain pending Codex identity until an authenticated first event arrives, and preserve exact-ID title/history refresh when a later event reports a previous identity. Never merge sessions by matching titles or timestamps.
- Accept one leading UTF-8 BOM at the Codex Hook reporter input boundary after the original raw 64 KiB limit. Preserve JSON/metadata validation, authentication and privacy filtering.
- Adapt supported Windows Codex launch routes and terminal capability, and retain the OpenCode observer without an auxiliary version probe.
- Read migrated OpenCode v2 history with nullable titles through the selected CLI database source. Create and rename supported sessions through authenticated official metadata APIs with exact readback, and refresh eligible history after database/WAL changes while respecting pure mode.

Important

- This stable release promotes the RC1-RC3 fixes to Latest and the stable updater as 0.26.0. The separately developed 0.27 update/recovery features and remote/mobile work are not included.
- Windows Hook regression uses synthetic events through the actual PowerShell wrapper, production reporter and authenticated local intake. The observed BOM prefix is supplied in the synthetic input on this development host; hosted test subprocesses use system PowerShell Modules only.
- Full installed Windows WebView, the original live duplicate-row case, account-backed model turns, D20 Layer-C, original unfiltered native All and real AI automatic naming remain unverified. Updater signatures do not certify Windows Authenticode or real installation/return acceptance. No universal duplicate-row fix or future CLI compatibility is claimed.
0.26.0.zh:
修复

- Codex 首次认证事件到达前保留待关联状态；后续事件报告旧身份时，继续按当前精确 ID 刷新标题与历史。不会按相同标题或时间戳合并会话。
- Codex Hook reporter 在原始 64 KiB 输入限制检查后兼容单个前导 UTF-8 BOM，保留 JSON/元数据校验、认证及隐私过滤。
- 适配受支持的 Windows Codex 启动路径与终端能力；OpenCode 观察无需额外版本探测。
- 通过所选 CLI 的数据库来源读取 OpenCode v2 迁移历史，兼容空标题；使用认证的官方元数据 API 创建、改名并精确回读，按数据库/WAL 变化刷新符合条件的历史，同时遵守纯净模式。

重要说明

- 本正式版将 RC1-RC3 修复发布为 0.26.0，并更新 Latest 与稳定更新通道。独立开发中的 0.27 更新/恢复功能及远程/手机端工作不包含在内。
- Windows Hook 回归使用合成事件，通过真实 PowerShell wrapper、生产 reporter 与认证的本地接收端。本研发机通过合成输入提供已观测的 BOM 前缀；hosted 测试子进程仅使用系统自带 PowerShell Modules。
- 完整安装版 Windows WebView、原现场双行会话、账户模型轮次、D20 Layer-C、原始未筛选 native All 和真实 AI 自动命名仍未验收。updater 签名不等于 Windows Authenticode，也不代表真实安装/返回验收。未宣称所有双行问题或未来 CLI 兼容性均已解决。

0.26.0-rc.3.en:
Fixed

- Accept one leading UTF-8 BOM in Codex Hook reporter input, including the prefix observed in a Windows PowerShell transport. Keep the original raw 64 KiB input limit, JSON and metadata validation, authentication and privacy filtering.

Important

- This is a prerelease test package. Download it explicitly; stable Latest and the stable updater channel remain unchanged.
- Regression checks exercise the production reporter, actual Windows PowerShell wrapper and authenticated local intake for SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit and Stop, including space, Chinese and apostrophe paths plus direct launch. This development host does not add a BOM itself; the observed prefix is supplied in synthetic input through the real chain.
- No real user conversation, model call or installed application restart is used. The reported live duplicate-row case, full installed Windows WebView, D20 Layer-C, original unfiltered native All and real AI automatic naming remain unverified. This correction does not certify every cause of duplicate rows.
0.26.0-rc.3.zh:
修复

- Codex Hook reporter 兼容输入开头的单个 UTF-8 BOM，覆盖 Windows PowerShell 传输中已观测到的前缀。继续保留原始 64 KiB 输入上限、JSON 与元数据校验、认证及隐私过滤。

重要说明

- 本版本是预发布测试包，需要显式下载；稳定版 Latest 与稳定更新通道保持不变。
- 回归使用生产 reporter、真实 Windows PowerShell wrapper 和认证的本地接收端，覆盖 SessionStart、UserPromptSubmit、Stop，包含空格、中文、单引号路径及直连启动。本研发机自身不会添加 BOM，因此将已观测前缀放入合成输入后通过真实链路验证。
- 未使用真实用户对话、调用模型或重启已安装应用。反馈中的真实双行会话、完整安装版 Windows WebView、D20 Layer-C、原始未筛选 native All 和真实 AI 自动命名仍未验收；本修复不代表所有双行原因均已排除。

0.26.0-rc.2.en:
Fixed

- Keep Codex title and history refresh active when an authenticated turn event reports a previous session ID, while retaining the current exact identity.
- Read migrated OpenCode v2 session history, including unnamed sessions, and resolve the selected CLI's database path without silently showing an old channel database.
- Create and rename supported OpenCode v2 sessions through the authenticated official metadata API. Accept an initially absent title and require exact title readback after a single rename request.
- Refresh OpenCode v2 history after database or WAL changes for an eligible owned resumed session. Treat these changes only as refresh cues; optional observation remains disabled in pure mode.

Important

- This is a prerelease test package. Download it explicitly; the stable Latest release and stable updater channel remain unchanged.
- OpenCode 2.2.5 metadata checks use isolated local roots without paid model calls. Database refresh cues do not certify live activity badges or account-backed model turns. Full installed Windows WebView, D20 Layer-C and real AI automatic naming remain unverified.
- The earlier field report of two rows with distinct native IDs is not fully certified fixed. Session identity remains exact; titles and timestamps never merge different sessions. Unsupported or future CLI contracts may lose optional enhancements.
0.26.0-rc.2.zh:
修复

- 认证回合事件携带旧会话 ID 时，Codex 仍能刷新标题和历史，同时保留当前确切身份。
- 读取 OpenCode v2 迁移后的会话历史，兼容未命名会话；通过所选 CLI 决议数据库路径，避免静默展示旧 channel 数据库。
- 使用认证的官方元数据接口创建和重命名受支持的 OpenCode v2 会话。允许初始标题缺失，但只发送一次改名请求，并严格回读验证标题。
- 对符合条件的已持有恢复会话，在数据库或 WAL 变化后刷新 OpenCode v2 历史；变化仅作为刷新信号，纯净模式继续禁用可选观察。

重要说明

- 这是预发布测试包，需要主动下载；稳定版 Latest 和稳定更新通道保持不变。
- OpenCode 2.2.5 元数据验证使用隔离本地目录，未调用付费模型。数据库刷新信号不代表实时活动角标或登录账号后的模型轮次已经认证；完整安装后的 Windows WebView、D20 Layer-C 和真实 AI 自动命名仍未验收。
- 之前现场出现两个不同原生 ID 行的问题尚未完整认证修复。身份继续严格匹配，不按标题或时间合并不同会话；不支持或未来变化的 CLI 契约可能失去可选增强。

0.26.0-rc.1.en:
Preview release

- Keep Codex identity pending until an authenticated event arrives, so a delayed first event does not falsely report that session linking is unavailable. Preserve exact-ID titles and history projection during refresh and close; restored runs still need a new authenticated event.
- Adapt the supported Windows Codex npm and canonical native launch routes by their same-run structure and authenticated events instead of a CLI version string. Observe OpenCode in the selected run without a version probe; retry at most twice after transient loopback transport failures using the same authenticated event ID.
- Declare the interactive PTY's terminal capability to avoid an inherited TERM=dumb warning. Keep Claude Code behavior unchanged.

Important

- This is a prerelease test package. It does not become the stable Latest release or an automatic stable update.
- The earlier field report of two rows with different native IDs is not root-caused or certified fixed. Never merge sessions by matching title or time. A diagnostic build completed one new-session title, refresh, close and restore sequence; the restored run's identity event, full installed-app flow and real AI automatic naming remain unverified.
- Arbitrary custom wrappers, legacy native layouts, Unix identity enhancement and future incompatible CLI protocols are not newly certified. An unsupported identity capability remains visible rather than silently inventing an association.
0.26.0-rc.1.zh:
预发布测试版

- Codex 首个身份事件延迟时保持等待状态，避免误报会话关联不可用；刷新和关闭时按确切 ID 保留标题与历史投影，恢复运行仍需新的认证事件。
- 已支持的 Windows Codex npm 与官方包原生启动路线依据同次运行结构和认证事件适配，不再以 CLI 版本文本准入。OpenCode 不再为观察功能额外探测版本；本地传输临时失败时最多以同一个认证事件 ID 重送两次。
- 为交互式 PTY 正确声明终端能力，避免继承 TERM=dumb 警告；Claude Code 行为保持不变。

重要说明

- 这是预发布测试包，不会成为稳定版 Latest，也不会自动进入稳定更新通道。
- 之前现场出现两个不同原生 ID 行的问题尚未查明根因，不能宣称已修复；不得按标题或时间合并会话。诊断包仅完成过一轮新建、命名、刷新、关闭与恢复；恢复运行的身份事件、完整安装应用流程和真实 AI 自动命名仍未验收。
- 任意自定义包装器、旧原生布局、Unix 身份增强及未来不兼容的 CLI 协议均未新增认证；关联能力不支持时应明确显示，不能虚构关联。

0.25.2.en:
Fixed

- Refresh Codex history titles after an idle transition, including delayed naming when no Stop hook arrives.
- Preserve readable names when a Codex title index has a partially appended record or exceeds the normal read limit; retain already observed same-source titles during incomplete close-time reads.

Important

- Identity hooks and supported launcher requirements remain unchanged. Sessions missing startup identity still require a supported launch or resume.
- Cold reads cannot recover older names outside the bounded large-index tail, or names saved only in Codex SQLite after index persistence fails. Title writes beyond the bounded retry window require another refresh cue.
- The reported field trigger, complete installed-app behavior and real AI automatic naming have not been certified.
0.25.2.zh:
修复

- Codex 进入空闲时刷新历史标题，覆盖未收到 Stop hook 时的延迟命名。
- 标题索引末尾记录尚未写完或超过普通读取上限时保留可读名称；关闭时读取不完整也保留此前确认的同源标题。

重要说明

- 身份 hook 与受支持启动方式的要求不变；缺少启动身份的会话仍需受支持的启动或恢复。
- 冷读无法恢复大索引有界尾窗之外的旧名称，也不支持索引写入失败后仅保存在 Codex SQLite 中的名称。超出有界重试窗口的标题写入需要另一次刷新信号。
- 尚未确认用户现场具体触发条件，也未认证完整安装应用和真实 AI 自动命名。

0.25.1.en:
Fixed

- Restore authenticated session identity for the audited official Windows npm Codex CLI 0.164.0 wrapper, allowing newly started sessions to follow CLI history titles and fold their exact history entry.

Important

- Start a new Codex session after updating. Existing sessions launched without identity hooks cannot acquire them by refreshing the list.
- Identity synchronization requires the supported direct-path npm 0.163.0 or 0.164.0 wrapper, enabled CLI hooks, and NODE_OPTIONS unset or empty. Native-executable and custom-launcher admission remains unchanged.
- Complete installed-app behavior and real AI automatic naming have not been certified for this patch.
0.25.1.zh:
修复

- 恢复已核对的 Windows 官方 npm Codex CLI 0.164.0 包装器的认证会话身份，使新启动会话可跟随 CLI 历史标题，并合并确切身份对应的历史条目。

重要说明

- 更新后请新建 Codex 会话。已在缺少身份 hook 时启动的会话，不能仅靠刷新列表补入 hook。
- 身份同步要求受支持的直接路径 npm 0.163.0 或 0.164.0 包装器、已启用的 CLI hooks，且 NODE_OPTIONS 未设置或为空。原生可执行文件及自定义启动器的准入范围保持原样。
- 本补丁尚未认证完整安装应用行为或真实 AI 自动命名。

0.25.0.en:
Added

- Toggle the session list with Ctrl+B on Windows/Linux or Cmd+B on macOS. Terminal input, editing fields and existing shortcut bindings keep priority.

Improved

- Update the Vue interface and native Tauri/TLS dependencies while preserving compact controls, saved settings and application permission boundaries.
- Strengthen automated regression checks and optional CI timing measurement without reducing the required test inventory.

Important

- Existing CLI model/provider settings and native session ownership remain unchanged. Optional CLI enhancements still depend on supported official interfaces.
- Account-backed model turns, D20 Layer-C, original native All and installed Windows WebView acceptance have not been certified for this source. Some Rust dependency advisories remain under review; no universal security or compatibility certification is claimed.
0.25.0.zh:
新增

- Windows/Linux 可用 Ctrl+B、macOS 可用 Cmd+B 折叠或展开会话列表。终端、输入框及已有快捷键绑定优先，不抢占 CLI 输入。

优化

- 更新 Vue 界面及 Tauri/TLS 等原生依赖，保留紧凑控件、已保存设置和应用权限边界。
- 完善自动回归和可选 CI 耗时测量，不减少必需测试库存。

重要说明

- 真实 CLI 的模型及 Provider 配置、原生会话所有权保持原有语义；可选增强仍取决于受支持的官方接口。
- 本次源码尚未认证登录账号后的模型轮次、D20 Layer-C、原始 native All 或已安装 Windows WebView 验收。部分 Rust 依赖公告仍在核查，不宣称全面安全或永远兼容。

0.24.0.en:
Added

- Use OpenCode alongside Claude Code and Codex CLI for native new sessions, exact-session resume, project preferences and local history, while keeping CLI model and provider settings in the original tools.

Fixed

- Start fresh settings with only Claude Code enabled and retain saved tool preferences. Keep compact icon-only switches and apply OpenCode history visibility immediately without stopping open terminals.
- Rename eligible OpenCode conversations through the official metadata API, verify the persisted title and hide unavailable rename actions. Show supported activity through the shared session badges, retaining distinct idle, working, permission, question, error and unknown states.
- Read OpenCode SQLite history coherently with WAL/SHM and honor safely scoped custom databases. Reject incomplete or invalid sources without silently losing older history or replaying an uncertain session-creation request.
- Keep newer Claude SessionStart identities when delayed Stop events arrive. Retain Codex title synchronization, exact history deduplication, active-session filtering and session-list keyboard focus fixes.

Important

- This is the stable 0.24.0 release. Installation remains your choice when an update is offered.
- Saving an OpenCode profile updates the workspace document. Older CC Desk versions can reject that document with WORKSPACE_INVALID; historical-version switching does not roll back shared CLI settings, history or project files.
- Optional OpenCode activity observation uses the examined official CLI 1.19.0 contract. Unrecognized versions skip it without making it a launch requirement; compatibility with every future CLI is not guaranteed.
- Account-backed model turns, D20 Layer-C, original native All and installed Windows WebView acceptance have not been certified for this source. Existing dependency advisories are unchanged by this release preparation.
0.24.0.zh:
新增

- OpenCode 与 Claude Code、Codex CLI 一起接入原生会话，支持新建、按确切会话恢复、项目偏好和本地历史；模型及 Provider 配置继续由原 CLI 管理。

修复

- 全新设置默认仅启用 Claude Code，保留已保存的工具偏好。恢复紧凑纯图标明暗开关，OpenCode 开关即时同步历史列表，不停止已打开的终端。
- 可安全验证来源的 OpenCode 会话通过官方元数据接口改名并回读持久化标题；不可用时隐藏入口。复用统一状态角标，区分空闲、工作、权限等待、问题等待、错误和未知状态。
- 一致读取 OpenCode SQLite 数据库及 WAL/SHM，支持经过作用域验证的自定义数据库；对不完整和异常来源明确拒绝，不静默丢失较早历史，也不重放结果不确定的会话创建请求。
- 避免迟到的 Claude Stop 覆盖较新的 SessionStart 身份，保留 Codex 标题同步、确切身份去重、活动筛选及会话列表快捷键焦点修复。

重要说明

- 本次为 0.24.0 正式版，发现更新后仍由你决定是否安装。
- 保存 OpenCode profile 会更新工作区文档；旧版 CC Desk 可能以 WORKSPACE_INVALID 拒绝读取。历史版本切换不会回滚共享 CLI 设置、会话历史或项目文件。
- OpenCode 可选活动观察采用已核查的官方 CLI 1.19.0 契约。未知版本跳过该增强，不作为启动前提；不保证所有未来 CLI 均兼容。
- 本次源码尚未认证登录账号后的模型轮次、D20 Layer-C、原始 native All 或已安装 Windows WebView 验收；本次发布准备未修复既有依赖安全公告。

0.24.0-rc.4.en:
Fixed

- Start fresh settings with only Claude Code enabled, while preserving every saved tool preference. Restore compact icon-only tool switches with reliable enabled/disabled brightness.
- Apply OpenCode support changes to session history immediately, without refreshing or stopping open terminals.
- Rename eligible OpenCode conversations through the official metadata API and retain their titles after restart. Hide rename actions when the source cannot be safely verified.
- Show OpenCode activity through the shared session badges, distinguishing working, idle, permissions, questions, errors and unknown state. Preserve identity and status across delayed events and clean up disposed observers.

Important

- This is a prerelease test package; the stable updater channel remains unchanged.
- Optional OpenCode activity observation is enabled only for the examined official CLI 1.19.0 contract. Unrecognized versions skip this enhancement without adding a launch requirement; compatibility with every future CLI is not guaranteed.
- Isolated official CLI metadata/plugin checks did not call a paid model. Account-backed model turns and installed Windows WebView acceptance have not been certified for this source.
0.24.0-rc.4.zh:
修复

- 全新设置默认仅启用 Claude Code，保留所有已保存的工具偏好。恢复紧凑纯图标开关，正确显示启用和停用的明暗变化。
- OpenCode 开关即时同步会话历史列表，无需手动刷新，也不停止已打开的终端。
- 可安全验证来源的 OpenCode 会话可通过官方元数据接口改名，重启后保留标题；无法安全改名时隐藏入口。
- OpenCode 接入统一会话角标，区分工作、空闲、权限等待、问题等待、错误和未知状态；处理迟到事件和观察器卸载，保留正确身份与状态。

重要说明

- 这是预发布测试包，稳定版自动更新通道保持不变。
- OpenCode 可选活动观察仅启用已核查的官方 CLI 1.19.0 契约。未知版本跳过该增强，不将它作为启动前提；不保证所有未来 CLI 都兼容。
- 隔离的官方 CLI 元数据和插件验证未调用付费模型。本次源码尚未认证登录账号后的模型轮次及已安装 Windows WebView 验收。

0.24.0-rc.3.en:
Unpublished candidate

- This candidate was not released because its main CI did not pass. Its provider settings and OpenCode fixes continue in 0.24.0-rc.4.
0.24.0-rc.3.zh:
未发布候选

- 此候选因 main CI 未通过而未发布。工具设置和 OpenCode 修复继续于 0.24.0-rc.4。

0.24.0-rc.2.en:
Test release

- Add OpenCode as a third native CLI with owned terminal launches, exact-ID resume and project-scoped SQLite history.
- Improve Claude Code session identity after delayed hooks, Codex command-wrapper compatibility, active session filtering and focused keyboard shortcuts.
- Keep optional OpenCode session preparation and history safe when the CLI, database schema or capability probe is unavailable.

Important

- This is a prerelease test package. Download and run it explicitly; the stable updater channel remains on the latest stable release.
- OpenCode integration was checked against official CLI 1.19.0 without paid model calls. Account-backed create/resume and installed Windows WebView acceptance remain separate checks. Older or future CLI versions may lose optional history or title features while basic terminal launch remains available.
0.24.0-rc.2.zh:
测试版本

- 新增 OpenCode 原生终端启动、按准确会话 ID 恢复，以及按项目归属读取 SQLite 历史。
- 改进 Claude Code 迟到 hook 的会话身份、Codex 命令包装器兼容性、活跃会话筛选和焦点快捷键。
- OpenCode 会话预备、历史读取或能力探测不可用时安全降级。

重要说明

- OpenCode 已针对官方 CLI 1.19.0 验证，未调用付费模型。登录账号后的创建和恢复、已安装 Windows WebView 验收仍需单独验证。旧版或未来版本可能失去可选历史或标题增强，但基础终端启动仍可使用。

0.23.5.en:
Fixed

- Restore new and resumed Codex sessions launched through Windows npm command wrappers.
- Keep automatic Codex titles and a single history entry when using the supported official npm wrapper.
- Apply launch-configuration changes without restarting CC Desk.

Important

- Codex title synchronization supports the official npm 0.163.0 wrapper at its direct path, with NODE_OPTIONS unset or empty. Other wrappers or Node options can still launch, but title synchronization and history deduplication may be unavailable.
- Historical-version rollback failures remain under investigation.
0.23.5.zh:
修复

- 恢复通过 Windows npm 命令包装器新建和继续 Codex 会话。
- 使用受支持的官方 npm 包装器时，同步 Codex 自动标题，刷新后保持单一历史条目。
- 修改启动配置后无需重启 CC Desk，即可继续打开会话。

重要说明

- Codex 标题同步支持直接路径下的官方 npm 0.163.0 包装器，且 NODE_OPTIONS 未设置或为空。其他包装器或 Node 选项仍可启动，但标题同步和历史去重可能不可用。
- 历史版本回滚失败仍在调查中。

0.23.4.en:
Added

- Quiet background update checks, with a notification in Settings when an update is available. You still choose when to install.

Improved

- New configurations start with Claude Code and its activity updates enabled. Existing CLI and observation preferences are preserved.

Fixed

- Restore Claude session activity updates and show Rename only for conversations that can be renamed.
- Show Codex automatic conversation titles and keep one session entry after refreshing.
- Keep dismissed history warnings consistent across the session list, notices and details.
- Let F2 follow session-list focus, leaving terminal function keys to the CLI.

Important

- Claude GUI rename requires Node.js 22.13 or newer on the launch configuration's PATH and readable local history. Codex title updates require compatible CLI support and may be unavailable when CLI hooks are disabled.
- Historical-version switching supports the approved Windows releases. Shared CLI settings, conversation history and project files are not rolled back; back up important data before switching.
0.23.4.zh:
新增

- 后台安静检查更新，有可用更新时在设置入口提醒；仍由你决定何时安装。

优化

- 新配置默认启用 Claude Code 及其活动更新，保留已有的 CLI 启用状态和观察偏好。

修复

- 恢复 Claude 会话活动更新，仅对可以修改原会话名称的条目显示重命名。
- 同步 Codex 自动生成的会话标题，刷新后不再多出一条关闭的会话。
- 在会话列表、提示和详情中一致保留已忽略的历史警告。
- F2 跟随会话列表焦点，终端功能键交给 CLI 处理。

重要说明

- Claude 界面重命名需要启动配置的 PATH 中已有 Node.js 22.13 或更新版本，并能读取本地历史。Codex 标题更新需要兼容的 CLI 支持，禁用 CLI hooks 时可能不可用。
- 历史版本切换仅支持已准入的 Windows 版本，不会回滚共享的 CLI 设置、会话历史或项目文件；切换前请备份重要数据。

0.23.3.en:
Fixed

- Keep the terminal's last row visible when resizing the window or changing fonts.
- Improve history refresh and recovery notices, and restore rename availability for readable conversations.
- Use the CC Desk application icon in the Windows installer.

Important

- Unreadable or damaged history sources can still leave the list incomplete. Resolve the file-access problem, then retry the affected source.
- Historical-version switching does not roll back shared CLI settings, conversation history or project files; back up important data before switching.
0.23.3.zh:
